evidence.quote: archived CSF samples available through a CSF biobank at the Columbia University Medical Center
Library preparation was carried out using the Zymo Quick-16S/V3V4 Plus NGS Library Prep Kit
All extractions included both negative (water only) and positive controls
a stringent abundance cutoff of 0.0001% was applied to remove extremely low-abundance taxa

notes: No CSF bacterial genus named in text: only spike-in organisms (Imtechella, Allobacillus) detected consistently; low-count 'Other' taxa (<20 reads) shown only in Fig. 1B and interpreted as contaminants/sequencing errors. Streptococcus pneumoniae only in meningitis positive-control sample (not recorded). No supplements available. Negative-control sequencing results not reported.
